subject: english
question: Choose the correct meaning of idiom: **Yeoman service**

options.text: An exceptionally loyal and useful service

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. "An exceptionally loyal and useful service".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Yeoman service"** refers to diligent, reliable, and helpful service that is performed loyally and effectively. (बहुत वफादार और उपयोगी सेवा)
 
 
 
• **Example:** During the flood relief operations, the volunteers provided yeoman service to the affected people.
 

 
• **"Exceptionally loyal and useful service"** captures the essence of the idiom. It is used to describe someone who has gone above and beyond to assist or contribute meaningfully. (अत्यधिक वफादार और उपयोगी सेवा)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The nurse's yeoman service at the hospital was appreciated by everyone.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: A trivial task done quickly** (एक मामूली कार्य जो जल्दी किया गया हो): Refers to something insignificant or simple that is completed in no time.

 
 
• **Example:** Folding laundry is often considered a trivial task done quickly.
 
 

 
• **Option 2: A dishonest act in uniform** (वर्दी में किया गया बेईमानी का कार्य): Refers to an unethical or deceitful act carried out by someone in a position of authority or responsibility.

 
 
• **Example:** A soldier committing theft while on duty is an example of a dishonest act in uniform.
 
 

 
• **Option 3: A brave but foolish deed** (एक साहसी लेकिन मूर्खतापूर्ण कार्य): Refers to an act of courage that lacks wisdom or results in unintended consequences.

 
 
• **Example:** Trying to rescue a wild animal bare-handed was a brave but foolish deed.

The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
